title: Step 27 Lambda-restored H3 monotonicity and closure audit
scope: Diagonal cohomogeneity-one H3 model; not a general Ricci-pinched collapse theorem and not a Yau-26 proof/refutation.

exact_Ricci_Lambda_equations.Ric00=Lambda_constraint: C_Lambda = b^2 + 4 k1^2 + 8 k1 k3 + 4 Lambda = 0

pinched_loss.eliminated_relation: S = 2 rho0 - 4 rho1 - 2 rho3, hence S <= -4 Lambda + 8 delta under |rho_i-Lambda|<=delta
pinched_loss.T_bound: |T|^2 >= (b^2+4 Lambda-8 delta)/2 whenever the right side is meaningful
pinched_loss.rate_bound: |d log b/dt|^2 >= (5/4)(b^2+4 Lambda-8 delta) whenever the right side is meaningful
pinched_loss.normalized_positive_threshold: For Lambda=1 and delta<1/2, the rate lower bound is positive even at b=0: |d log b/dt| >= sqrt(5(1-2 delta)).
pinched_loss.exact_positive_threshold: For delta=0, Lambda>0, |d log b/dt| >= sqrt(5 Lambda) everywhere and |d(1/b)/dt| >= sqrt(5)/2 on {b>0}.

CH2_negative_witness.interpretation: The negative Einstein horosphere data have constant bracket: C=0 and d(log b)=0 because b^2+4 Lambda=-5<0 makes the positive-branch lower bounds vacuous.

initial_data_for_any_B_positive.k3_0: -B/2 - Lambda/B (so for Lambda=1 and B=20 this is -10.05)

periodic_orbit_space.statement: No C^1 positive periodic b can satisfy |(log b)'|^2 >= c0>0. Hence no exact Ric=Lambda>0, or pinched Lambda>0 with delta<Lambda/2, diagonal H3 model over S^1.
periodic_orbit_space.proof: The derivative of log b is continuous and never zero, so it has constant sign; log b is strictly monotone, contradicting periodicity. Equivalently a positive periodic C^1 function has a critical point.

two_center_bolt_interval.statement: If the only smooth compactification allowed at both finite ends is collapse of the central circle with a -> a0>0 and c -> 0, then b=c/a^2 -> 0 at both ends, so an interior maximum of b exists; the positive rate lower bound forbids it.
two_center_bolt_interval.fidelity_warning: This is not yet a classification of every possible singular orbit for a nilmanifold principal orbit. It proves the standard periodic/two-center-bolt diagonal closures and identifies the endpoint-classification needed before saying all closed diagonal H3 cohomogeneity-one manifolds are excluded.

large_b_shell.exact_Lambda_nonnegative: On {b>=B}, |d(1/b)/dt| = |d log b/dt|/b >= sqrt(5)/2, so a monotone component reaching arbitrarily large b has thickness <= 2/(sqrt(5) B) from b=B to b=infinity.
large_b_shell.curvature_concentration: The sectional curvature K12 = -3 b^2/4 - k1^2 always satisfies |K12| >= 3 b^2/4; large nonabelian bracket is a thin high-curvature shell in the positive model.

research_judgment: The Step-26 inequalities do contain a strong positive-branch model theorem: positive Lambda forbids a bracket plateau and makes ungraded H3 collapse a monotone high-curvature shell. The closed periodic/two-center-bolt diagonal models are excluded. A fully unconditional “no closed diagonal H3 cohomogeneity-one structure” statement still needs endpoint/singular-orbit classification; twist-active higher-base models remain outside this A=0 codimension-one calculation.
